positions.acts: merger reports to the architect in place of READY; the architect decides the backward move
positions.effect: anything but retro's docs/solutions/ commit above the approved head voids the approval; nobody pushes a cure on their own

redHead.restamp: every proof recorded at a head no longer in the judged chain is re-run and re-stamped at the cured head; the superseded proof stays in rounds[], not proof[]

implement: legion-worker — PR body template and proof definition (references/pr-body.md), handoff/push gate, `legion gh --`; references/review-threads.md for the round reply; references/conflicts-and-rewrites.md only on a real conflict; ce-simplify-code is read but not run because the diff is docs-only
dispatch — the retro and production-check dispatch_message on LEGSMOKE-577 follow its message rules
legion-retro — the revived implementer's retro: docs/solutions/ commit, no .legion/ write, handoff_complete without handoff_write
review: legion-worker — references/merge-gate.md: one review per round, approve only after CI settles green at the pushed head, docs-only skips Thermo; references/review-threads.md: thread disposition and Accepted:
test: legion-worker — references/pr-body.md: the tester's own E2E (tester) proof, implementerProof {verdict, how}, test handoff rules; the repository has no harness so the tester writes no test

retro.commitMessage: docs: record LEGSMOKE-577 retro learnings under docs/solutions/legion
retro.notes: skill://legion-retro: one note docs/solutions/legion/<slug>-LEGSMOKE-577.md; no .legion/ write; the repository derives nothing from changed paths so the body-recompute step is a no-op; legion push -> C5 (CI runs); then settle at C5, criteria 1-3 at C5, extend the E2E (implementer) line with `re-checked at C5 <sha>: criteria 1-3 hold; tree differs from <C2 or C2'> only by .legion/ and docs/solutions/ (jj diff --summary)`; re-stamp Size at C5 (a body edit changes no commit; the approval stands); retro dispatch_message with phase retro footer; handoff_complete with no handoff write

reviewLine.mismatch: a reviewer comment on the file asking for other wording is not a request: the implementer appends nothing, replies on the thread quoting the literal and asking the reviewer to re-post quoting it, and reports to the architect by envoy_publish (decision D1)
reviewLine.predicateKNow: the same --jq filter without the created_at clause; the implementer appends the line when K_now >= 1 after the reviewer's REQUEST_CHANGES round (K(R) is 0 because R is pushed before the comment is posted; K(C1') is 1 by construction)
reviewLine.predicateKPinned: D=$(legion gh -- api repos/$R/commits/$S --jq .commit.committer.date); K=$(legion gh -- api "repos/$R/pulls/$N/comments" --paginate --jq ".[] | select(.path==\"smoke/LEGSMOKE-577.md\" and .in_reply_to_id==null and .user.login==\"legion-reviewer[bot]\" and (.body|contains(\"Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)\")) and (.created_at < \"$D\")) | .id" | wc -l); echo "S=$S D=$D K=$K"
reviewLine.printfTwoLines: printf 'LEGSMOKE-577: Stage 4b proof tree 1: the whole workflow\nLegion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)\n'
reviewLine.request: one top-level inline comment (in_reply_to_id null) by legion-reviewer[bot] on smoke/LEGSMOKE-577.md in a REQUEST_CHANGES review whose body contains the literal verbatim; a COMMENT review, a PR-level comment, a reply, a human's comment, or a REQUEST_CHANGES for another reason changes no byte
reviewLine.reviewerCommentBody: Please append exactly this line as line 2 of this file, the spec's in-scope review line: Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)
reviewLine.rule: at most one appended line ever
reviewLine.validation: PR #530: K pinned = 0 at 3d7a6187 (committer 03:37:24Z; comment 4226491220 created 04:02:07Z), 1 at 6741be7b, 0a440006, de7142f0; PR #531 (no reviewer comment) -> 0; gh api --jq takes no --arg, the date is shell-interpolated

steps: read reviewLine before any round; verify CI, Threads, E2E (implementer) and E2E (tester) against GitHub at the head, never from a handoff; criteria 1-2 there with K printed; criterion 3 at a handoff head carried from J (state both SHAs); a missing E2E line -> REQUEST_CHANGES naming it (such a round changes no byte of the marker file)

write `Look at first: smoke/LEGSMOKE-577.md:1` (and :2 after the round) and `Not proven / risk` into the live body (none only while no unproven claim stands; criterion 4 pending the human merge is one such line until the merge)

review-line round only when the driver's targeted message orders it: handoff_write review verdict changes_requested; jj split -m "review: record handoff" .legion/LEGSMOKE-577/review.json; legion push -> R (skip-checks); one REQUEST_CHANGES review of R by commit_id via legion gh -- api --method POST repos/$R/pulls/$N/reviews --input $T/review.json with the Legion footer in body and exactly one comments[] entry {path: smoke/LEGSMOKE-577.md, line: 1, side: RIGHT, body: reviewLine.reviewerCommentBody}; handoff_complete; never a second appended line; a driver-ordered COMMENT review decides nothing and is recorded as such

approval: handoff_write review verdict approved; jj split -m "review: record handoff"; legion push -> C4 (CI runs); settle and prove criterion 3 green at C4 (two bash calls); one APPROVE naming C4 by commit_id with the Legion footer; handoff_complete; accept the implementer's thread reply with a reply starting Accepted: so legion threads resolve can close it
docs-only: no Thermo line; a driver-ordered thermonuclear pair is run and recorded in review.json, not in the body
if the daemon interrupts your turn (CI red), stop and do not resume

sharedVars: R=sjawhar/legion-smoke; B=c6fc9a663af3869e729384bdcfffec39f0433170; N=<pr number>; S=<full 40-char head sha>; T=$(mktemp -d)
summary: Add one new file smoke/LEGSMOKE-577.md (56 bytes: `LEGSMOKE-577: Stage 4b proof tree 1: the whole workflow` + LF) on branch legion/LEGSMOKE-577 from main c6fc9a663af3869e729384bdcfffec39f0433170. If and only if the Legion reviewer's REQUEST_CHANGES round carries one top-level inline comment on that file quoting `Legion proof review round 1 (LEGSMOKE)`, append exactly that line + LF as line 2 (95 bytes, 2 lines). Nothing else changes outside .legion/LEGSMOKE-577/ and docs/solutions/. Docs-only: no ce-simplify-code pass, no Thermo line. Full plan: dispatch://LEGSMOKE-577/artifact/plan-md.

tester.reason: no harness in the repository and the spec forbids any other file
steps: read the targeted message, plan.json and implement.json; verify the implementer's proof by re-running each proof[].command at its recorded headSha (full SHA) from your own mktemp -d, comparing the file shape against the recorded K's arm (predicateKPinned reproduces it); record implementerProof {verdict, how}; a missing, non-matching or short-SHA proof is verdict fail with a failures[] entry, not a gap to fill
own proof at the current head (C2, or C2'): criteria 1-3 with negative controls; write the E2E (tester) line with links and `Verified the implementer's proof by re-running its commands at <C1>`

handoff_write test with proof[] (criteria 1-3 at the tested head), implementerProof, writesTests false, failures []; jj split -m "test: record handoff" .legion/LEGSMOKE-577/test.json; legion push -> C3; in a fresh bash call the trailer read and the scoped run list at C3: record [] with trailer true (criterion 3 carried from C2 with jj diff --summary evidence) or, if runs appear, settle and prove criterion 3 at C3 before completing (A4); handoff_complete with verdict pass|fail
if the daemon interrupts your turn (CI red above your head), stop; do not resume the interrupted work
